comparison.objective: Fit a carriage onto a rail and push it past a spring plunger; candidate adjusts the damping of an already assembled carriage axis.
comparison.physical_skill: Rail alignment and constrained sliding versus tool-mediated unlocking, rotary adjustment, relocking, and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage aligned, past plunger, against stop, released and still versus two controlled impacts within stroke and lock-retention limits.
comparison.reason: A carriage and stop appear in both, but one tests rail assembly while the other tests closed-loop damper commissioning.
